verdict.rationale: Chroma is a vector database and cloud service, and a product of that kind could plausibly offer user-configurable background jobs, triggers or scheduled tasks, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows automatic embedding and indexing on write, which is built-in ingestion behavior, not user-defined automations or recurring schedules that run on their own. No documented capability for setting up autonomous background automations appears in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
